decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line was launched recently, fits the firm's core natural skincare offer and is featured on its own page, so a small firm would keep developing it rather than drop it after one year.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a popular, low-cost addition to an established facial range that small batch production can sustain, so there is little reason to withdraw it this early.
A cleansing milk is a staple of natural facial care that complements the other lines and costs little to keep in a batch-based assortment.
